sections.title: باب 6 — متن (220)

paras.text: … has disgraced me. Not so; rather you people do not care for the orphan, nor do you urge feeding the needy, and you gather up the property of inheritance and eat it, and you hold wealth very dear. Not so — when the earth is pounded and levelled, and your Lord will manifest Himself and the angels will come rank upon rank, and Hell will be brought before on that day, then on that day man will think, but now where can thinking benefit him? He will say: would that I had sent something ahead for this life of mine! Then on that day no one will punish like the punishment of Allah, nor will anyone bind like His binding. O soul at peace, return towards your Lord; you are pleased with Him and He is pleased with you. So enter among My special servants, and enter My Paradise.

sections.content:
… has disgraced me. Not so; rather you people do not care for the orphan, nor do you urge feeding the needy, and you gather up the property of inheritance and eat it, and you hold wealth very dear. Not so — when the earth is pounded and levelled, and your Lord will manifest Himself and the angels will come rank upon rank, and Hell will be brought before on that day, then on that day man will think, but now where can thinking benefit him? He will say: would that I had sent something ahead for this life of mine! Then on that day no one will punish like the punishment of Allah, nor will anyone bind like His binding. O soul at peace, return towards your Lord; you are pleased with Him and He is pleased with you. So enter among My special servants, and enter My Paradise.

Lexical explanation:

[wa] is for oath.

[al-Fajr] The time of morning when the darkness of night clears and dawn breaks.

[al-Shaf'] Even, making a pair.

[al-Watr] Odd, single.

[Hijr] Intellect: the literal meaning of hijr is to restrain, and since intellect restrains from foolishness, it was therefore called hijr.

['Ad] The name of a nation among the former nations, which had made great progress in the art of building. Carving mountains, they used to make beautiful palaces inside them. These people were unique in this art.

[Iram] He was the forefather of the people of 'Ad. The genealogy of Iram is Iram bin Sam bin Nuh.

['Imad] Tall pillars are called so. This is an allusion to their constructional progress.

[Thamud] These people were from the descendants of 'Ad and became their heirs in the passion for building; so they have also been called the second 'Ad. Their dwelling was "Wadi al-Qura".

[jabu al-sakhr] To make holes in rock; to split.

[dhi al-awtad] Possessor of stakes. According to Arab idiom, by dhi al-awtad is meant possessor of grandeur and pomp. And in some narrations it has come that in Pharaoh's court one method of punishment was that the criminal was laid on the ground and stakes were driven into his hands and feet; that is why Pharaoh was called dhi al-awtad.

[taghaw] They had exceeded the limit; they had become rebellious.

paras.text: [fa-sabba 'alayhim rabbuka sawta 'adhab] In this saying of Allah there is metaphor (isti'arah). The severity of the punishment of Allah has been likened to pouring water: that just as fast as water falls, with that same speed the punishment of Allah descended upon them. The meaning of sabba is to pour, and the meaning of sawt is whip; that is, the whip of Allah's punishment rained upon them.
paras.urdu: [فَصَبَّ عَلَيْهِمْ رَبُّكَ سَوْطَ عَذَابٍ] اللہ کے اس قول میں استعارہ ہے۔ اللہ کے عذاب کی سختی کو پانی انڈیلنے سے تشبیہ دی ہے۔ کہ جس تیزی سے پانی گرتا ہے اتنی ہی تیزی سے اللہ کا عذاب ان پر نازل ہوا۔ صبّ کا معنی ہے انڈیلنا اور سوط کا معنی ہے کوڑا۔ یعنی اللہ کے عذاب کا کوڑا ان پر برسا۔
paras.pashto: [فصب علیهم ربک سوط عذاب] د الله په دې قول کې استعاره ده. د الله د عذاب سختي د اوبو تویولو سره تشبیه شوې: لکه څومره چې اوبه په چټکۍ لوېږي، همغومره چټکۍ سره پرې د الله عذاب نازل شو. د «صب» مانا تویول، او د «سوط» مانا کوړه ده؛ یعنې د الله د عذاب کوړه پرې ووریده.

paras.text: [inna rabbaka la-bil-mirsad] al-Mirsad: the path or place of watching, the place of lying in ambush. In this verse there is metaphor. In it Allah's watching over His servants has been likened to lying in ambush.
paras.urdu: [اِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَبِالْمِرْصَادِ] المرصاد: نگرانی کا راستہ یا جگہ، گھات لگانے کی جگہ۔ اس آیت میں استعارہ ہے۔ اس میں اللہ کی بندوں پر نگرانی کو گھات لگانے سے تشبیہ دی گئی ہے۔
paras.pashto: [ان ربک لبالمرصاد] المرصاد: د څار لاره یا ځای، د کمین ځای. په دې آیت کې استعاره ده؛ په کې پر بندګانو د الله څار د کمین نیولو سره تشبیه شوی.

[fa-sabba 'alayhim rabbuka sawta 'adhab] In this saying of Allah there is metaphor (isti'arah). The severity of the punishment of Allah has been likened to pouring water: that just as fast as water falls, with that same speed the punishment of Allah descended upon them. The meaning of sabba is to pour, and the meaning of sawt is whip; that is, the whip of Allah's punishment rained upon them.

[inna rabbaka la-bil-mirsad] al-Mirsad: the path or place of watching, the place of lying in ambush. In this verse there is metaphor. In it Allah's watching over His servants has been likened to lying in ambush.

[ibtalahu] He tested him.

[tahaddun] To incite one another to some work.

[lamman] To gather.

[jamman] To be abundant, to be excessive.

[idha dukkat al-ard] To remove the ups and downs of the earth and make it level. It is an indication towards the Day of Judgement, that the earth will be levelled.

[yaqulu ya laytani qaddamtu li-hayati] In it the regret of man is mentioned, that on that day he will say: would that I had sent ahead some good deeds for the next life.

[wathaqah] To bind, to imprison.

[al-nafs al-mutma'innah] That is, that soul which passed life in the obedience and pleasure of Allah the Exalted.

فَصَبَّ عَلَيْهِمْ رَبُّكَ سَوْطَ عَذَابٍ ۞ اِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَبِالْمِرْصَادِ

In it saj' (rhymed prose) too has occurred.
